# rotg

![rotg function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/blas/12-rotg.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

Computes r,c,s,z from x,y. The complex instance retains a real c and complex r,s,z. GS complex z copies original y; that convention is not NI-certified. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. NI confirms z CDB but does not define its exact convention. GS complex z copies original y, corresponding to unchanged Netlib B; this is not NI-certified. Optional unwired defaults: none.

<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**rotg**
